name: Almost Heaven Himalaya 4-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Himalaya 4-Person Indoor Sauna Elevate your relaxation with Almost Heaven Saunas' Himalayan Series, combining the time-honored sauna tradition with the holistic benefits of Himalayan salt. The full-wall salt feature, radiantly backlit, not only creates an ambiance but may also offer advantages such as improved respiratory function, skin hydration, and stress relief. With comfortable multi-level seating for up to four individuals and a 6 kW heater that reaches temperatures of 190°F and beyond, the Himalaya 4-person indoor sauna is a haven of rejuvenation. Its Nordic spruce construction and full-glass front seamlessly integrate with your home decor, making it a wellness centerpiece that blends sophistication with serenity. Features High-grade smooth-grain Nordic spruce Tongue-and-groove construction: 1-3/8” finished thickness Horizontal and vertical wood wall sections Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Pre-assembled wall sections, roof sections, benches, and backrests Utilizes the existing floor. Suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door and windows Built-in vent with sliding cover Himalayan pink salt rear wall Back-lit lighting on the salt wall with multi-color choices Hand-held remote to change lighting functions Upper and lower benches for multi-level seating Indoor usage Full glass front wall Hand-crafted construction Best-in-class 6kw heater & sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Hand-crafted workmanship Specifications Seats up to four people Indoor usage Heater size: 6 kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Hand-held remote for lighting operation Exterior dimensions: 81"W x 54”D x 80”H Interior dimensions: 78”W x 51”D x 78”H Lower bench size: 48”L x 24”W x 18”H Upper bench size: 78”L x 24”W x 36”H Upper bench L extension Size: 34”L x 24”W x 36”H 1-1/2” thick element wall and roof sections 5/16” thick tempered door and window glass Handcrafted construction Door can be assembled to swing right or left Upper bench can be assembled with L on the left or right Shipping weight: 1125 lbs Note: All dimensions are approximate Options & Customizations Lumber: The Himalaya 4-person indoor sauna is constructed using thick Nordic Spruce pieces of lumber. This sturdy lumber is perfect for a free-standing sauna and offers plenty of natural insulation. Heater: Up the Himalaya Small sauna from a standard 6kw Wall Heater to a Virta deluxe heater! Specific models are also available with WIFI options. Care & Maintenance Traditional saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance here. Shipping & Assembly The Himalaya 6-person indoor sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. See the shipping tab for more details. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Two Ways to Enjoy Your Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Resources Himalaya Small Installation and Owner's Manual Videos
